historical_reviews.deepseek: YES; prints a bus without segment/device/function context, length or non-PCI sentinel validation.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; adds complete-address validation but lowers capability for inputs.

original_test_intent: Validate the Type 41 Bus Number byte as the bus component of the correct domain:bus:device.function for each onboard LAN record, including complete non-PCI sentinel handling and reboot stability.
original_method: Validate Type 41 length and raw bus byte, combine it with segment and device/function, bind the complete address to the approved LAN identity/read-only PCI inventory or non-PCI rule, then repeat after reboot.
manual_activity: A user supplies the complete LAN PCI/non-PCI map and approves reboot; bus decode/correlation is automated.
required_inputs: Expected complete domain:bus:device.function per onboard LAN
Applicable non-PCI sentinel rule across segment/bus/device-function
Type 41 raw parser and domain-aware lspci/sysfs inventory
Approved reboot and OOB recovery independent of tested LAN
safety_requirements: Do not rescan PCI, reset devices, bind/unbind drivers or alter LAN configuration.
Never compare Bus Number without segment and device/function context.
For non-PCI records, validate the complete sentinel tuple rather than the bus byte alone.
Stop on network/management recovery failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Validate length/raw bus, assemble complete BDF, apply PCI/non-PCI rules, correlate stable LAN/PCI identity and diff across reboot.
Report malformed, ambiguous, mismatched or drifting addresses without assigning PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve onboard LAN address/non-PCI topology and reboot plan.
Resolve platform enumeration exceptions and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The label is relevant, but a bus value alone cannot prove complete PCI identity or correct non-PCI encoding.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive raw/decoded Type 41 plus domain-aware PCI inventory; emit identity, raw bus, complete BDF/sentinel tuple and pre/post result.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Bus Number scope, script and 5/5-minute values remain; no enumeration change is added.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Treat Bus Number as one byte of the Type 41 complete address, correlate the entire domain:BDF with stable onboard LAN identity or validate the complete non-PCI sentinel tuple across reboot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Systems publishing Type 41 records for onboard LAN.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, board/BIOS, parser/dmidecode, pciutils and kernel versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 41 Segment, Bus and Device/Function definitions plus platform PCI map.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds complete-address ownership, fixed-length and non-PCI tuple validation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects same-bus false matches across segments, wrong device/function and partial sentinel encodings.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Bus numbering can change with platform firmware/configuration; any approved change must be traced to a deliberate baseline revision, not auto-accepted.

project_override_considerations: Projects may define expected enumeration or non-PCI records, but must compare the full tuple and cannot authorize rescans/reconfiguration under this case.
expected_evidence: Pre-reboot Type 41 handles/lengths and raw address bytes
Complete decoded domain:BDF or sentinel tuple with LAN/PCI identity correlation
Statement that no PCI/LAN state changed
Approved reboot/network/OOB record and post-reboot complete-address diff

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Bus Number is a valid Type 41 address field; complete address context is required to preserve its meaning.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Raw byte and complete-address correlation are fully automatable after topology inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds full BDF/domain ownership, length and non-PCI tuple rules.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains no-rescan safety while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE capability.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates topology/reboot readiness and formal verdict from capability.

review_improvement: Eliminates false matches caused by identical bus numbers on different segments or by validating only one byte of a non-PCI sentinel tuple.
independent_technical_reasoning: A PCI bus number has no globally unique meaning; it is correct only within the complete domain:BDF and stable onboard-device identity.
